authority.final_supervisor_decision: Record NO LICENSED CONSTRUCTION for the e97-tanh-state vs fla-gdn pair; DO NOT LAUNCH; commit and push the terminal finding with concession #16 and the S5 correction.
authority.design_gate: No launch without a citable wrapper-proof for the requested experimental pair and dimensions.

finding: The tracked theory licenses no expressivity separation between the experimental architecture pair.
scope_limit: Absence of a licensed separator is not a proof of equal capacity, a proof that wrappers compensate for every task, or a training outcome.

candidate_audit.construction: E97 temporal composition versus GDN conditioned affine fold
candidate_audit.disposition: Structural raw-state characterization only; arbitrary input-only schedule generators preserve conditional affinity, but nonlinear encoders/decoders do not preserve the output affine identity. No wrapped task lower bound.

candidate_audit.construction: S5 tracker and GDN routing bridge
candidate_audit.disposition: S5 has an explicit 5x5 general linear-state realization. Bridge excludes only token-independent schedules, not the experimental arm; production-constrained realization remains open G3.

candidate_audit.construction: 120-state recognizer floor, 480-key lookup table, d=12 generator memory
candidate_audit.disposition: Capacity floor applies to both arms; table/generator memory is not an autonomous E97 all-words realization or a GDN impossibility.

candidate_audit.construction: One-step and finite-k delta/raw-write resource separation
candidate_audit.disposition: Excluded fixed-right/raw-write M2RNN resource is not fla-gdn; no arbitrary-wrapper separation for the requested pair.
Sufficient tanh slot bounds only, with additional production-range applicability gaps; no bare or wrapped GDN impossibility.

candidate_audit.source: Elementary specialization of CompositionalDepthDuality definitions and affine identity, not an additional Lean theorem
candidate_audit.disposition: Rejected: bare continuous-state structural regression, compensated by identity state propagation plus tanh decoder; not a temporal token-task separator.

outcomes.name: SEPARATION
outcomes.requested_meaning: E97 fits and linear fla-gdn remains below a preregistered ceiling after at least 2x strong-arm convergence updates plus LR annealing.

outcomes.name: WRAPPER-COMPENSATES
outcomes.requested_meaning: Both wrapped arms fit a valid selected task.

outcomes.name: TASK-BROKEN
outcomes.requested_meaning: Linear arm fits and nonlinear arm fails.

outcome_registration_limit: All four categories are retained but inactive. No target passed the design gate, so no empirical outcome, numerical ceiling, update budget, or task protocol is registered. A future experiment requires a new approved preregistration before data collection.

corrections.correction: Supervisor retracted triangle-map / 3g1 construction names cited from memory: they do not identify constructions in the tracked theory.

Supervisor also retracted the suggestion that noncommutative S5 accumulation is a licensed separator from bounded-dimensional linear-state folds: the tracked paper explicitly supplies a 5x5 linear realization.

recommended_next_step: Independent review of this source audit; require a new dimension- and wrapper-aware lower bound before designing a separation launch.
